entries.text: Hurry up and hide! And keep quiet, OK?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_02

entries.text: Phew... That was close.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_03

entries.text: Whatcha doing?
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_select_01

entries.text: Something up?
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_select_02

entries.text: Um... Yeah, you know, I’m just... Errr...\c\n*sigh*\nGuess I might as well come clean.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_04

entries.text: Take a look over there.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_05

entries.text: Do you get it now?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_06

entries.text: ...Not really?
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_select_03

entries.text: A little context, please?
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_select_04

entries.text: Ah. Sorry. Your jump scare earlier completely\nfrazzled me. My brain’s still trying to reboot.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_07

entries.text: All right, here’s the sitch. Team Star’ve started\ncoming to school again...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_08

entries.text: But I don’t know if they’re gonna fit in OK, and\nit’s been playing on my mind, you know?\r\nSo I’m checking on them from over here...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_09

entries.text: Hmph... Guess we’re still not exactly gettin’ a\nwarm welcome here, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_aku_01

entries.text: Well, duh.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_fairy_01

entries.text: Sure, the teachers finally figured out we’re not a\nbunch of delinquents...[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_fairy_02

entries.text: But it’s not like we can press some magic button\nto make everyone else accept us.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_fairy_03

entries.text: True story. We gotta fix this, my man. Time for a\nchange of tack![VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_aku_02

entries.text: Huh? A change of tack...?\c\nWhat, are they gonna start wearing normal school\nuniforms so they stop scaring off the other kids?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_10

entries.text: Oh, Momo... Ortie... They’re both really trying\ntheir best to fit in here at school...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_11

entries.text: A “change of tack,” huh? What exactly are\nyou suggesting?[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_fairy_04

entries.text: Buh? I mean, uhhh...[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_aku_03

entries.text: How ’bout we say a big, friendly howdy to\neveryone here? Like, just yell it. Loud as we can.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_aku_04

entries.text: WHAT?! That’s stupid! Go on and embarrass\nyourself if you want to, but count me out![VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_fairy_05

entries.text: Errr. Yeah, that idea seems a bit...off.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_12

entries.text: Hold up—lemme explain.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_aku_05

entries.text: You know Ryme, right? She does this at her\nconcerts, no joke.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_aku_06

entries.text:
If the crowd ain’t hyped at the start of the show,
she’ll shout the loudest greetin’ you ever heard
into the mike. Like “S’UP Y’ALL” or whatever!\c
Lifts the mood like nobody’s business.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_aku_07

entries.text: Yeah, that makes sense. ’Cause those are\nCONCERTS. This is SCHOOL. It’s different.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_fairy_06

entries.text: OK, smart guy. So we’re optin’ for the cold\nshoulder treatment forever, then, are we?[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_aku_08

entries.text: N-no... That’d totally suck.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_fairy_07

entries.text: It would, wouldn’t it? So yeah. Our only option is\nto yell at everyone so they know we’re nice.\r\nHere, I’m gonna go for it...[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_aku_09

entries.text: HEEEY!!! MORNIN’, Y’AAAAAALL!!!\nHOW WE ALL FEELIN’ TODAAAY??!![VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_aku_10

entries.text: Oh nooo! Giacomo! What are you DOING?!\nThis is SO embarrassing![VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_fairy_08

entries.text: EVERYONE HAVIN’ A GOOD TIIIIIIME??!!\nC’mon, Ortega—you gotta do it, too![VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_aku_11

entries.text: Hold on a sec! You...you’re just practicing for\nyour DJ sets, aren’t you?[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_fairy_09

entries.text: THANKS FOR COMIN’ TONIGHT!!!\nQuick! Say it![VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_aku_12

entries.text: TH-THANKS FOR COMING TONIGHT!!![VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_fairy_10

entries.text: ...HEY! What do you mean, “thanks for coming”?!\nWe’re not hosting anything![VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_fairy_11

entries.text: What. On. Earth.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_13

entries.text: Are those guys from Team Star? What the heck\nare they yelling for?
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_mob_01

entries.text: Is this some kind of skit? Heh...they’re pretty\nfunny!
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_mob_02

entries.text: I guess they’re not as scary as I thought...?
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_mob_03

entries.text: P-people are actually warming up to them?!\nWhy? That makes zero sense![VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_15

entries.text: Haaah... Momo and Ortie really are operating\non a different level. I’m kind of amazed.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_16

entries.text: Seems all my worrying was for nothing, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_17

entries.text: Now that that’s all settled, I guess I should get\ngoing. Hasta la vistar! ☆[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_a_18
